summary: The recorded reason still holds when checked against primary sources (2026-11-16). The paper's data-availability statement still cites GSE267200, which GEO deleted on 2025-02-04 with no replacement pointer. GSE289461 still deposits only eight per-mouse DGE matrices, with no retained barcodes or cell labels, so the 19,020-cell author cohort cannot be reconstructed. The author DE is cell-level Seurat FindMarkers within individual clusters (Table S1 covers non-neuronal clusters), which is a different estimand from the registered whole-ARC mouse-pseudobulk KO-minus-control logFC. No author-concordance-v2 comparison is valid. One stale fact was corrected: GEO now links GSE289461 to PubMed 40112816, but there is still no accession or sample crosswalk.

manualReview.summary: Mettl14 knockout deposit and paper use materially different cell cohorts
manualReview.note: The staged replacement-accession RAW archive and SOFT record match their committed hashes, and the local pipeline aggregates sections/runs within four mice per genotype for knockout minus control. The paper still cites GSE267200, which GEO staff deleted on 2025-02-04 without a replacement pointer; current GSE289461 (last updated 2026-10-06) has eight samples and now links PubMed 40112816, but neither record gives an old-to-new accession or sample mapping, and the paper's data-availability statement still cites only GSE267200. The paper reports 19,020 cells (9,111 WT and 9,909 KO), while replacement GSE289461 contains 208,711 DGE columns. Applying the published >500-gene and <5%-mitochondrial QC rules yields 36,342 cells, proving that additional cell calling/filtering is missing. The accessible supplementary workbook contains cluster DE/GO summaries rather than retained barcodes, cell labels, or an all-cell result comparable to the registered pseudobulk.
reviewFlags: No deterministic repair is possible without filtered barcodes, cell types, and a deleted-GSE267200 to replacement-GSE289461 mapping.
